# GLOWD

> GLOWD is an iPhone face score app that maps facial landmarks, explains 11 facial ratios, and creates a personalized glow-up plan.

## Primary pages
- [GLOWD home](https://glowd.tech/): Product overview, app screens, privacy summary, and FAQ.
- [Methodology](https://glowd.tech/methodology): Landmark detection, ratio calculation, scoring curve, reference context, privacy, and limitations.
- [Facial ratios](https://glowd.tech/facial-ratios): Plain-language definitions for the 11 ratios shown in the app.

## Product facts
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 17 or later.
- Face mapping: dense MediaPipe landmark mesh processed on device.
- Visible report: 11 facial ratios with measurement context.
- Privacy: face photos and facial landmark analysis are not uploaded for processing.
- Positioning: entertainment and educational guidance, not medical advice or an objective definition of beauty.

## Official app
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/glowd-face-score-glow-up/id6760931929
